remarks: Enjoy this recently updated & spacious two-bedroom, two full bath condo unit at the desirable Regency Towers complex in Stamford's booming Metropolis! This bright & sunny unit has a fabulous floor plan. Improvements include kitchen upgrades, fresh paint & floor refinishing providing a move-in ready option. The living room is expansive & leads to the screened-in balcony with lovely views. Is cooking your thing? Then you will love this kitchen which boasts all new stainless-steel appliances, new quartz countertops, gas stove & white cabinets. Serve up your gourmet meal in the formal dining room or sit out on the balcony for an al fresco experience. The primary bedroom suite is generous in size & offers a full wall of closets plus an ensuite bath with a walk-in shower. The second bedroom is also spacious & has easy access to the second full bath with a tub/shower combination. Find warm-toned refinished parquet floors throughout the unit. You'll find closet space galore for all of your storage needs. Special features include a grand lobby, 24/7 doorman service, updated security system, deeded garage parking space, visitor parking and an on-site superintendent. Laundry on every floor for your convenience. Heat, hot water & cooking gas are included in the HOA fees. Great location with the ultimate in shopping, restaurants, entertainment, transportation, & parks all close by. Come to Regency Towers where residents enjoy Stamford beach rights & all this wonderful city has to offer.
